headline: Lim Kwang-hyun: "42% of High-Value Corporate Housing Is Used Privately... Tax Investigation Into 'Emperor Housing' to Be Conducted"
summary: National Tax Service Commissioner Lim Kwang-hyun said 42% of high-value corporate housing is used privately. The agency will run rigorous tax investigations into companies where wrongdoing is confirmed.
why: Tax enforcement on corporate perks affects company valuations, governance and compliance costs for Korean listed firms. The National Tax Service is South Korea's national tax authority.
